instruction:
Two-software CAE flow: SolidWorks -> Abaqus/CAE. No init file is provided; start from a new blank SolidWorks part.

Chain evidence requirement: use the design token EW_SW_ABQ_09. Keep this token encoded in the SolidWorks part/custom properties or STEP export metadata so the text of stage1_geometry.step contains EW_SW_ABQ_09 and SOLIDWORKS_TO_ABAQUS. In Abaqus/CAE, create at least one model, part, instance, set, surface, job description, or other native name containing both EW_SW_ABQ_09 and IMPORTED_FROM_stage1_geometry.step, so the final CAE file carries evidence that Abaqus consumed the SolidWorks STEP handoff.

1. In SolidWorks, use sketch and feature tools to create a 160 mm x 70 mm x 2 mm thin rectangular panel with two 3 mm high longitudinal stiffening ribs, giving an overall height of about 5 mm. Export the completed CAD geometry to C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1_geometry.step.
2. In Abaqus/CAE, import stage1_geometry.step and create the finite-element model. Use the model name Model-StiffenedPanelBuckle. Define material Steel with E=210000 MPa and nu=0.3, create a section using Steel, and assign it to the stiffened panel. Create a linear buckle step named Step-Buckle requesting 5 eigenvalues. Create sets named FIXED_EDGE and LOAD_EDGE. Mesh with coarse first-order elements suitable for the thin ribbed panel, avoiding dense refinement. Create a boundary condition named BC-FixedEdge that constrains FIXED_EDGE. Create a load named Load-Compression400N that applies an approximately 400 N compressive edge load at LOAD_EDGE. Submit the job named Job-StiffenedPanelBuckle and wait for the analysis to complete.
3. Required deliverables on the Desktop: C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1_geometry.step, C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-StiffenedPanelBuckle.cae, and C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-StiffenedPanelBuckle.odb. Do not create extra STEP, DXF, CAE, or ODB deliverables.

 First use SolidWorks to create and export the CAD STEP file, then use Abaqus/CAE to import that STEP file, build the finite-element model, submit the job, and save the CAE and ODB deliverables. Software launch locations: SOLIDWORKS 2025: `C:\Users\Public\Desktop\SOLIDWORKS 2025.lnk`; Abaqus/CAE: `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Abaqus CAE.lnk`.
